name: Read a Room
description: Reads a room's posts, oldest first. With no start it gives the latest ones, so a plain read shows the last ten posts. Needs crud/read on x/room/<name>, unless the room lets anyone read. To page back, read again with start set to the first post's number minus limit.

room.description: The room's name: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as tau-collab.

start.description: The number of the first post to give. Optional: by default, end minus limit, so the read shows the latest posts. Posts the owner has pruned are skipped.

limit.description: How many posts at most. Optional, 10 by default.

output.description: room; posts, oldest first; first, the number of the oldest post the room still holds; end, the number the next post will take. A room with no posts has first equal to end.
